gate: Hash frozen before the holdout. Official engine 1.32.7, paired against Frontier13 (f13_c22_lock, our live submission) on identical opponents/seeds/seats, both seats. Gate: total paired score >= +4 over the 19-rival panel, score against Frontier13 itself (mirror, the game the new slot would play against our other slot's rivals' copies) >= 50%, score against exact cha22 >= 70%, no opponent with a paired delta below -2.0, no reported errors/fallbacks, every callback < 1000 ms. The panel spans the post-lock top (cha22, haideptry v7, Shepherd's Ledger, Master Engine V4), the private-variant families that beat us live (Wangyh v41/v44 and mooman E081/E082 from GitHub, local evaluation only), the pre-lock top and the low-band families for the climb (a1-t31, hack, utils-v1/V43, shop-router v7). Extra candidates play the panel for comparison only. Then the Kaggle kernel on four fresh seeds (total > 0, no opponent below the control). Registered before the run.
